meta.title: Service maturity portfolio
meta.subject: Brent
meta.disclaimer: Illustrative model. The service names are representative of a London borough's service estate; every maturity rating and volume below is a placeholder for discussion, not an assessment of Brent Council's actual services. Not an official Brent Council product.

stages.name: Offline only
stages.desc: Phone, post or in person. Nothing online.

stages.name: Signposted
stages.desc: Findable and explained online. You are told where to go and what you need.

stages.name: General answer
stages.desc: The answer is published and is identical for everyone who asks.

stages.name: Personalised answer
stages.desc: One public detail — a postcode — returns an exact answer. No sign-in, no account.

stages.name: Submit
stages.desc: An online form, not signed in, re-keyed by hand at the back. Digital front, manual back.

stages.name: Authenticated
stages.desc: Signed in and verified. We already know you, fields are pre-filled, it completes.

stages.name: Straight-through
stages.desc: Lands in the line-of-business system with no re-keying. Immediate confirmed outcome, trackable.

stages.name: Proactive
stages.desc: We act without being asked: entitlement applied automatically, auto-renewal, told before you have to ask.

escalation_track.name: Escalate by design
escalation_track.desc: Urgent, statutory or safeguarding demand that should never be self-service. These are not a low rung — the goal is not to move them up the ladder. The only maturity question is whether the front door recognises them instantly and hands over to a named team with context.
